test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In March 2023, who was appointed as Chairperson of Pension Fund Regulatory Development Authority (PFRDA)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Deepak Mohanty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deepak Mohanty** was appointed as the Chairperson of the **Pension Fund Regulatory Development Authority (PFRDA)** in **March 2023**.
 
• The **Pension Fund Regulatory Development Authority** is a statutory body under the **Ministry of Finance**, Government of India.
 
• It regulates and develops the **pension sector** in India.
 
• Deepak Mohanty is a former executive director of the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**.
 
• His appointment was approved by the **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)**, headed by the Prime Minister of India.
 
• He succeeded **Sujata Das**, who held the position temporarily after the retirement of the previous chairperson, **Supratim Bandyopadhyay**.
 
• The PFRDA oversees the functioning of the **National Pension System (NPS)** and other pension schemes in India.
 
• The appointment of Deepak Mohanty is expected to provide strong leadership to enhance the development and regulation of the pension sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Subodh Jaiswal**__

 __
 
• **Subodh Jaiswal** is the Director of the **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)**.
 
• He is an Indian Police Service (IPS) officer of the **1985 Maharashtra cadre**.
 
• Jaiswal has served in various roles, including as the Director-General of Police in **Maharashtra**.
 
 
 
• **Suresh N Patel**__
 __
 
• **Suresh N Patel** is the Chief of the **Central Vigilance Commission (CVC)**.
 
• The **CVC** is an anti-corruption watchdog in India tasked with monitoring the integrity of government organizations.
 
• Patel has extensive experience in banking and vigilance-related roles.
 
 
 
• **Tushar Mehta**__
 
 
• **Tushar Mehta** is the Solicitor General of India.
 
• The Solicitor General assists the Attorney General and represents the Government of India in legal matters.
 
• Mehta has been involved in high-profile legal cases and has represented the government in the Supreme Court.
